title: Alert changed, version 1: the data of the CloudEvent
description: Published once each time an alert starts firing and once when it is resolved. The twelve fields are required; a producer may add more.

alertId.description: Identifies one alert; the same value when it fires and when it is resolved.

organization.description: The slug of the Organization, or the empty string for a platform alert.

cluster.description: The cluster the alert is about.

entityKind.description: The kind of the entity the alert is about.

entityName.description: The name of the entity the alert is about.

startsAt.description: When the alert started firing, in RFC 3339.
